context: A boss and his manager discuss an industry article
purpose: Teach: 主流/開拓/起源/利害/出生/嫉妬/増強/莫大

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この記事、主流市場の起源を辿る話、面白い。
lines.en: This article—the way it traces the origins of the mainstream market. Interesting.
lines.style: Measured opening. Slight pause mid-thought as he collects the idea. Approving tone without excess emphasis. Calm authority, genuine intellectual interest. A brief reflective nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新市場の開拓、莫大な投資が必要との分析です。
lines.en: Yes. The analysis shows that developing new markets requires substantial capital investment.
lines.style: Crisp, professional delivery. Presents the fact cleanly without editorializing. Alert posture—ready to expand if pressed. Respect in the pacing, no rushing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 利害調整、業界内で嫉妬が芽生えるのは避けたい。
lines.en: Stakeholder alignment is crucial. We need to be careful not to stir up resentment within the industry.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured cadence. Weighs each word—this is strategic territory. Slight emphasis on 「careful」 shows he's thinking aloud, not lecturing. Collaborative tone underneath the analysis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 出生率の低下も、需要見通しに影響します。
lines.en: Declining birth rates will pressure the demand forecast as well.
lines.style: Steady, observant delivery. Raises the point like he's connecting threads others might have missed. No alarm, just clarity. Quiet confidence in the data he's synthesized.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 設備増強、来年度の議題に。
lines.en: Capacity expansion goes on next year's agenda.
lines.style: Decisive, clipped. Not abrupt—just efficient. Final word falls with quiet authority. Signals the decision is made, the path is set. A closing note, not an opening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Quiet, direct acknowledgment. Single nod in the voice. Professional but warm—shows he was listening and agrees. Closes the exchange.
